name: Real estate
looksLike: a website listing homes for sale or rent
a site with property photos prices and viewing requests
a place to filter houses by location and budget
definition: A website for discovering and comparing properties, with structured listing details, photographs, location context, and a clear way to ask questions or arrange a viewing.
goal: Help visitors evaluate suitable properties and contact a representative.
audience: People researching homes or other properties

sections.name: Property search
sections.purpose: Filter by location, budget, and practical requirements.

sections.name: Results
sections.purpose: Show price, location, and key facts consistently.

sections.name: Property details
sections.purpose: Present photographs, specifications, and important disclosures.

sections.name: Enquiry and viewing
sections.purpose: Offer a contact route and viewing request.

mustHave: A visible contact and correction route

prompts.short: Build a property site with search filters, clear listing facts, photo galleries, and viewing enquiries.
prompts.detailed: Build a real estate website for people researching homes or other properties. Help visitors evaluate suitable properties and contact a representative. Include property search, results, property details, enquiry and viewing. Use responsive layouts, clear labels, keyboard access, and visible focus. Accurate prices and listing status.
